result.reason: The operative language does not reach the preferred position: the fixed-dollar limb is left blank rather than set at USD 1,000,000, and no mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages is included. It also does not cleanly reach the fallback because “Fees” remains defined solely as the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, so referring to Fees under all Order Forms does not establish a cap based on all fees paid or payable during the preceding 12 months. The carve-outs, mutuality, and payment-obligation treatment are otherwise aligned, and the edits are narrowly targeted. The unresolved placeholder and defective fee definition make the clause incomplete; the margin comment does not cure the operative language.
